<%
      let yOffset = 0
      const width = large ? 920 : 760
      const padding = 15
      const lineHeight = 22
      const codeLineHeight = 20

      // Parse markdown content from config
      const markdownContent = config.markdown || "No markdown content provided. Use the 'markdown' configuration option to provide content."

      // Helper function to render text with word wrapping
      function wrapText(text, maxWidth, fontSize = 14) {
        const words = text.split(' ')
        const lines = []
        let currentLine = ''
        const charWidth = fontSize * 0.55 // Approximate character width

        for (const word of words) {
          const testLine = currentLine ? currentLine + ' ' + word : word
          const testWidth = testLine.length * charWidth

          if (testWidth > maxWidth && currentLine) {
            lines.push(currentLine)
            currentLine = word
          } else {
            currentLine = testLine
          }
        }
        if (currentLine) lines.push(currentLine)
        return lines
      }

      // Parse markdown into sections
      function parseMarkdown(content) {
        const lines = content.split('\n')
        const sections = []
        let currentCodeBlock = null
        let currentList = null

        for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
          const line = lines[i]

          // Code block start/end
          if (line.trim().startsWith('```')) {
            if (currentCodeBlock) {
              sections.push({ type: 'code', content: currentCodeBlock.join('\n'), lang: currentCodeBlock.lang })
              currentCodeBlock = null
            } else {
              const lang = line.trim().substring(3).trim()
              currentCodeBlock = { lines: [], lang }
            }
            continue
          }

          if (currentCodeBlock) {
            currentCodeBlock.lines.push(line)
            continue
          }

          // Headers
          if (line.match(/^#{1,6}\s/)) {
            if (currentList) {
              sections.push({ type: 'list', items: currentList })
              currentList = null
            }
            const level = line.match(/^#+/)[0].length
            const text = line.replace(/^#+\s*/, '')
            sections.push({ type: 'header', level, text })
            continue
          }

          // List items
          if (line.match(/^\s*[-*]\s/)) {
            const text = line.replace(/^\s*[-*]\s*/, '')
            if (!currentList) currentList = []
            currentList.push(text)
            continue
          }

          // End list if not a list item
          if (currentList && !line.match(/^\s*[-*]\s/)) {
            sections.push({ type: 'list', items: currentList })
            currentList = null
          }

          // Horizontal rule
          if (line.match(/^---+$/)) {
            sections.push({ type: 'hr' })
            continue
          }

          // Regular paragraph
          if (line.trim()) {
            sections.push({ type: 'paragraph', text: line.trim() })
          }
        }

        // Close any remaining blocks
        if (currentCodeBlock) {
          sections.push({ type: 'code', content: currentCodeBlock.lines.join('\n'), lang: currentCodeBlock.lang })
        }
        if (currentList) {
          sections.push({ type: 'list', items: currentList })
        }

        return sections
      }

      const sections = parseMarkdown(markdownContent)
    %>

    <% if (warnings.length) { %>
      
      <g class="warning-section" transform="translate(0, <%= yOffset %>)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="<%= width %>" height="40" fill="#fff3cd" stroke="#ffc107" stroke-width="1" rx="6"/>
        
          ⚠ <%= warnings.map(({warning}) => warning.message).join(", ") %>
